subject: PO header & invoice cadence for ClearDevice - procurement constraints
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cleardevice.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Jensen <maria.jensen@cleardevice.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements + invoice cadence (ClearDevice)

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week. Procurement asked me to confirm a few requirements before we can move the PO through our internal systems:

- Our AP team requires a PO header on every invoice with a unique PO identifier (format: PO-XXXXX).
- We need an "acceptance code" field on invoices for automated matching with our ERP. Example label: ACCEPT_CODE or PO_ACCEPT_ID.
- Net60 is our baseline for new vendors; can you confirm Redwood's flexibility on net terms (Net45 / Net60)?
- Preferred invoice cadence is weekly consolidated statements (one consolidating invoice per week) with a CSV line-item extract for ledger mapping.

Attached is our vendor onboarding form and a small PO sample that shows the fields our systems expect. Can you review and confirm whether Redwood can provide the PO header and acceptance code as part of the invoice metadata? We aim to execute a blanket PO for FY27 but need these details cleared to submit the request.

Samantha Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearDevice
[attachment: ClearDevice_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: ClearDevice_PO_sample.csv (csv)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cleardevice.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (ClearDevice)

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear checklist and the attachments. Short answers up front: yes, we can put a PO header on invoices and include an acceptance code field; net terms are negotiable depending on commitment level; invoice cadence we can support but need to align on billing consolidation and reporting format.

Options we typically offer for customers with procurement constraints:
- Standard: Net45, monthly consolidated invoice (no fees).
- Flexible: Net60 with weekly consolidated invoices (requires a small operational fee because of increased AP overhead).
- Commitment path: Net45 + tiered discount slab (0.5%–2%) for annual committed spend, weekly detail CSV included.

To move fast, attached a Redwood PO template that includes a PO_ID and ACCEPT_CODE fields. Vanessa and Ben are looped in — Vanessa for pricing/discount packaging, Ben for billing acceptance & ERP mapping. Marissa will help with the mutual action plan for procurement.

If it's helpful, I'd propose a short 30-minute call tomorrow to align on which option ClearDevice prefers so we can get the blanket PO submitted.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether ClearDevice can accept Net45 for a 12-month committed volume (we'll propose a discount slab).
2) If not, confirm Net60 and whether the weekly invoice cadence is a hard requirement.
3) Share the exact header/field mapping for ACCEPT_CODE and any required CSV column names.

I'll send a quick mutual action plan draft after we hear back.

Best,
Logan Wright
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_PO_template.csv (csv)]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cleardevice.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Jensen <maria.jensen@cleardevice.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (ClearDevice)

Logan —

Thanks for the quick reply and the template. A couple points from procurement:

- We cannot accept an operational fee attached to billing cadence. The only levers we can pull are term length and committed spend.
- We can move to Net45 if Redwood provides a committed annual minimum and applies a pricing credit (we'd like to see a concrete discount percentage by tier).
- Weekly invoices are a hard requirement because our vendor payments team needs the cadence for cash planning; however, we are okay with a single consolidated weekly invoice plus a machine-readable CSV detail.
- For acceptance code, our ERP expects the field name PO_ACCEPT_ID and a 10-character alphanumeric code. Example in supplied CSV.

Attached is a slightly expanded PO sample with the EXACT column headers our system uses. Can you confirm Redwood can populate PO_ACCEPT_ID on invoices (not just in a PDF)? If Redwood can map the CSV so our ERP can ingest directly, procurement will prioritize the submission.

We can do a call tomorrow at 10am PT. Maria will join as well.

Samantha
[attachment: ClearDevice_PO_sample_v2.csv (csv)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cleardevice.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO requirements + invoice cadence (ClearDevice)

Samantha / ClearDevice team —

Thanks for the detail and for being candid about cadence and fee constraints. Here is a workable compromise from Redwood's side:

1) Terms & pricing:
   - We can offer Net45 terms if ClearDevice executes a blanket PO for a 12-month committed ARR tier (we'll put the tiers in the commercial addendum).
   - For the commitment path, Redwood will provide a 1.5% credit on invoices (applied as a monthly credit against consolidated billing) for commitments >= $150k ARR; 0.75% for commitments between $75k–$150k.

2) Invoice cadence & metadata:
   - Redwood can produce a consolidated weekly invoice (one invoice per week) with a CSV attachment that contains line-level detail.
   - We will populate the PO header field using your PO-XXXXX format and include the PO_ACCEPT_ID field in the CSV exactly as provided. The PO_ACCEPT_ID will also be stored in the invoice metadata for machine ingestion.

3) Operational steps:
   - Marissa will send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists dates for: PO submission, vendor onboarding form completion, test CSV ingestion, and go-live.
   - We'll require the signed blanket PO and the vendor onboarding form. Once received, we will provision Net45 and the discount slab per the commitment.

Attachments: Redwood has attached an updated MSA redline and a sample weekly invoice + CSV layout. Please review and confirm acceptance so our legal/sales ops teams can generate the DocuSign envelope (link below).

DocuSign (sample): https://www.docusign.com/cleardevice-contract/DL-4471
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.app/deals/DL-4471

If that matches your requirements, please confirm and we'll send the MAP and DocuSign. If you prefer not to commit to annual volume, we can still support weekly invoices under Net60 but without the discount credit.

Ben Carter
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline.pdf (pdf)]
